Mr. PEGGOTTY’S DREAM COMES TRUE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u052-b0062", "target": "Неужели он никогда, никогда не придёт? Сколько мне ещё это терпеть? Как долго я смогу это терпеть? — О я несчастная, о я несчастная! — воскликнула злополучная Эмили тоном, который, как мне думалось, мог бы тронуть самое чёрствое сердце; но в улыбке Розы Дартл не было ни тени смягчения. — Что, что мне делать!", "source_sha256": "9a5e491eb1359cf5ce59155d38090be3d432540b85362860c6429b3cd96ce5e8", "target_id": "ru-en85-u052-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "80890ff2e6f681d667022e1352c6bc657813d12d23389c120f78878e2210a8f8"}, {"source_id": "en85-u052-b0063", "target": "— Делать? — отозвалась та. — Жить счастливо в собственных размышлениях! Посвяти свою жизнь воспоминанию о нежности Джеймса Стирфорта — он сделал бы тебя женой своего слуги, не так ли? — или чувству благодарности к честному и достойному человеку, который взял бы тебя как его подарок. Или, если эти гордые воспоминания, и сознание собственных добродетелей, и почётное положение, до которого они возвели тебя в глазах всего, что носит человеческий облик, тебя не поддержат, выходи замуж за этого славного человека и будь счастлива его снисхождением. Если и это не годится, умри! Для такой смерти и такого отчаяния есть подворотни и мусорные кучи — найди одну и лети на небеса!", "source_sha256": "1abbea5952c5e10fb72b075c37895178d042871fda210775e6dd807c08e364ba", "target_id": "ru-en85-u052-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ac8964555b702a35923b60b5c06bbdf2c0e7e83e56915c4c02213b191cf48e4f"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 50, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u052-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I heard a distant foot upon the stairs. I knew it, I was certain. It was his, thank God!", "sha256": "3310bb2cf80bd7764219b47d070ac2bc721a05ebca08298be96ac2ac986967ed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She moved slowly from before the door when she said this, and passed out of my sight.", "sha256": "13630376c8135c127c39c28aa09790dbcdefc787882a7b3d811b79418a525a9f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But mark!’ she added, slowly and sternly, opening the other door to go away, ‘I am resolved, for reasons that I have and hatreds that I entertain, to cast you out, unless you withdraw from my reach altogether, or drop your pretty mask. This is what I had to say; and what I say, I mean to do!’", "sha256": "b30d7951007e9562bf322b67d1f4ad9454c1416dd73672ab3866123a0ccdcbeb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The foot upon the stairs came nearer—nearer—passed her as she went down—rushed into the room!", "sha256": "75dc421aae17ab535f9d85c4124ba17898f6237fba4332a76d7361bb57cb2f6c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Uncle!’", "sha256": "6fa9fac8c07b3707a4cf5a2346e74405fa51779bd71f51c9622c1ac0063f189c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A fearful cry followed the word. I paused a moment, and looking in, saw him supporting her insensible figure in his arms. He gazed for a few seconds in the face; then stooped to kiss it—oh, how tenderly!—and drew a handkerchief before it.", "sha256": "96585cd0906bf9de32f7f1cd10148b4750a26c4a5fa8a746e7b7d3b218abeb5b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mas’r Davy,’ he said, in a low tremulous voice, when it was covered, ‘I thank my Heav’nly Father as my dream’s come true! I thank Him hearty for having guided of me, in His own ways, to my darling!’", "sha256": "f6d672424a0dc81ea8bf0997de60a762db07ec7fcd9ed7f5543567ea711c2c7e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u052-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With those words he took her up in his arms; and, with the veiled face lying on his bosom, and addressed towards his own, carried her, motionless and unconscious, down the stairs.", "sha256": "e3ce85067bbbf0f3b7861557590b647bc532d089f13b603e544de336fc4d35f3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[57]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
